verdict: Red 9/10 REJECT, blue 9/10 SUSTAINED - the strongest and cleanest kill in this batch, and the only one where both benches read the decisive primary text directly rather than through a mirror. The thesis's sole claim to court-worthiness was an information-asymmetry claim: that the post-TDAPA Medicare price for Vafseo was unresolved and reconstructible from public CMS data ahead of the market. That is factually wrong. CMS published the number on 2026-06-26 in the CY2027 ESRD PPS proposed rule (91 FR 38784): Table 12, p.38811 gives Vafseo a post-TDAPA add-on of $0.9437 per treatment for all four CY2027 quarters, computed as trailing-2025 Vafseo spend divided by ALL ESRD treatments times a 0.65 risk-sharing factor, and paid on every ESRD PPS claim whether Vafseo is dispensed or not. Blue re-read pp.38807-38814 and cross-footed it: $0.9437 / 0.65 x ~40M treatments is approximately $58M, which matches Vafseo's actual 2025 revenue - the number is internally consistent with the issuer's own financials. Against a currently realized ~$61 per treatment, marginal Medicare reimbursement for dispensing Vafseo after 12/31/26 is effectively zero. The rule predates the 8/5 -24% move, so the tape already has the number; the reconstruction edge expired six weeks before the brief was written. The residual bull branch dies on the same text: a flat-2027 Vafseo line would require roughly 4-5x the patient count in one year into zero-marginal-payment facility economics, since management's own 'ESA-range pricing' language implies roughly -80% net price against a $299.55 base rate. Blue added a second, un-modeled, date-certain cliff that neither the thesis nor red carried: pp.38808-38809 propose folding phosphate binders into the base rate at +$15.96 on 2027-01-01, ending Auryxia's TDAPA - so branded Auryxia competes inside a fixed bundle against generics from the same date. Blue reduced two red findings and was right to: the Korsuva 'utilization collapse' framing is partly mechanical expiry rather than behavioral, and the DefenCath add-on actually ROSE across rule years ($2.3710 to $5.5951), so post-TDAPA utilization can grow - direction survives, the 'template' framing does not. Blue also demoted the Form 144 timing finding (filed one day before the VOICE stop PR) to PLAUSIBLE-flagged: the adjacent Form 4 cluster aligns with an annual-meeting grant pattern and the stock fell through the positive PR anyway. Neither reduction is load-bearing. Under the response taxonomy this is a business-risk and data kill, not a valuation gate - the payment mechanism, not the multiple, is what broke. Blue explicitly ruled RP_FAIR unavailable: the financing-spiral tail is unbounded, carry is zero, and the runway is refinancing-conditioned ($29.3M H1 burn against a $49.6M senior-secured term loan whose refinancing is conditioned in) in a sub-$1 equity that forecloses cheap equity. Orphan discipline does not bind - AKBA is a covered, high-attention name post-events. Nothing survives that supports a position.
